name: minimal-mistakes
description: Minimal Mistakes Jekyll theme npm build scripts
author: Michael Rose

scripts.build:js: npm run uglify && npm run add-banner
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build:js && node --check assets/js/main.min.js && node scripts/test-watch-js.mjs
scripts.verify:site: npm run verify && bundle exec ruby scripts/test-check-site.rb && npm run build:site && bundle exec ruby scripts/check-site.rb _site --release && node scripts/check-readability.mjs _site .artifacts/readability
